trophies.detail: Clear a Side Op or Extra Op

trophies.detail: Clear all missions (including Side Ops and Extra Ops)

trophies.name: Skilled
trophies.detail: Clear any mission (including Side Ops and Extra Ops) with a S-rank

trophies.name: Hero
trophies.detail: Clear all missions (including Side Ops and Extra Ops) with a S-rank

trophies.name: Rescue
trophies.detail: In the "Ground Zeroes" mission, rescue the prisoner to be executed and extract him via chopper

trophies.name: Depth

trophies.name: Pacifist
trophies.detail: Clear the "Intel Operative Rescue" Side Op without killing a single enemy

trophies.name: Infiltration
trophies.detail: Clear the "Classified Intel Acquisition" Side Op while riding in the back of a truck

trophies.name: Extraction
trophies.detail: In the "Destroy the Anti-Air Emplacements" Side Op, rescue and extract all prisoners via chopper

trophies.name: Reminiscence
trophies.detail: Recreate all scenes in the "Déjà-Vu" Extra Op
